provenance: Original concise public overview notes. The documentation contains illustrative source excerpts; none were copied or used as fixtures. No upstream implementation or test-suite files were opened. No execution parity claim.
publicBehavior: Duplicate reports can identify multiple source locations for a repeated block

nativePolicy.identity: Group already verified pairs by exact language, token count and normalized signature; do not infer additional matches or merge distinct signatures transitively
nativePolicy.occurrences: Deduplicate exact path/start/end locations within each group; retain UTF-16 offsets and one-based line/column positions with exclusive ends
nativePolicy.ordering: Groups by decreasing token count, language and signature; occurrences by path, start and end
nativePolicy.overlap: Different groups may overlap; collected locations from different nonoverlapping pairs need not all be mutually nonoverlapping
nativePolicy.reports: cloneGroups in JSON and SARIF run properties; group and summed occurrence counts in text; no source text
nativePolicy.compatibility: Preserve pair findings, gates, baseline identities and method fingerprints; omit metadata when disabled and return an empty array when enabled without matches
nativePolicy.bounds: Derived from at most 10,000 verified pairs: at most 10,000 groups and 20,000 location entries
nativePolicy.limits: Original view across thirteen modes; no CPD grouping or complete lexer/options equivalence claim
